Use advice for data set: Scope: This EPD represents the weighted average of the following five gypsum plaster dry mix products: - Bulgips Start; - MP75; - MP75 L; - MP75 SL; - ROTBAND. All plasters are manufactured by: Knauf Radika AD, 8-mi Septemvri bb 1250 Debar, Republic of North Macedonia. The LCA considers specific information provided by the manufacturer and suppliers of components exclusively for the cradle-to-gate production stage. The end-of-life stage is modelled based on a developed scenario. System boundary: This EPD covers the production stage, the end-of-life stage and module D in accordance with EN 15804, i.e. the scope is cradle-to-gate with options. The production stage (modules A1-A3) includes the production of raw materials and their transport to the manufacturing site, production processes, packaging and the preparation for delivery, as well as the use of electricity, fuels and water. The end-of-life stage (modules C1-C4) includes the processes of dismantling/demolition of the building, transport of gypsum plaster waste, waste processing and disposal. | |
Technical purpose of product or process: The specific recommended applications of the products are as follows: - Bulgips Start: intended for indoor machine application as two-layer plaster in various residential building systems (hotels, hospitals, administrative premises), including premises with normal air humidity acc. to DIN 18550-1 and DIN 18550-2. Bulgips Start can be applied on walls and ceilings on various substrates: porous concrete, silicate masonry units, pumice, concrete masonry, mixed masonry, gypsum fibreboards or stone walls. - MP75, MP75 L and MP75 SL: intended for indoor machine application to create smooth surfaces on walls and ceilings. It can be applied in one layer on all types of masonry, concrete and stable plasterable foundations; in all premises with normal humidity, incl. domestic kitchens and bathrooms; as a base for subsequent finishing or wallpapers, as a basis for tiles and finishing plasters. - ROTBAND: intended for indoor manual application to be used on concrete slabs, walls, pre-cast concrete elements and on all plasterable substrates. The product can be used in humid premises (kitchens, bathrooms) acc. to DIN V 18550. | |
General comment on data set: Knauf gypsum plasters are factory-made pre-mixed dry gypsum plasters produced in accordance with EN 13279. All declared plasters consist of mineral binders (mainly natural gypsum and hydrated lime in a small amount), fillers and additives. The declaration refers to the declared unit of 1 kg of an average gypsum plaster dry mix product with weighted average density of 870 kg/m3. The following products are included in this EPD: - Bulgips Start; - MP75; - MP75 L; - MP75 SL; - ROTBAND. | |
Technology description including backgro: The primary components by mass in all plasters are gypsum (varying between 60% to 90% among products) and natural gypsum (between 4.5% and 25% among products). The raw gypsum is extracted from the quarries by drilling, blasting and excavating processes. The raw gypsum follows several processing steps to be used in the plaster dry mixes. First, the gypsum undergoes primary crushing (impact crusher) that reduces the gypsum to grains of <100 mm. Then a screening process follows to separate properly crushed grains with the required size from larger grains and grains with impurities. The properly crushed fraction 0-40 mm is discharged in a storage silo, while larger grains undergo secondary crushing (impact crusher) before being also sent to the silo. The perlite is delivered to the factory by an external supplier packed in PE big bags and is stored in a dedicated silo. The raw perlite is dosed to the furnace via weighing conveyor belt. The perlite is expanded at temperature of 750 °C. Limestone (calcium carbonate) crushed sand ready milled to ≈200 μm used as filler is delivered in bulk by an external company and is stored in silos. The hydrated lime is also delivered in bulk by external suppliers. A modifying compound, retarder and hydrated lime used as additives in all plaster products are also supplied by other companies. All ingredients (gypsum, expanded perlite, limestone filler and additives) are dosed and supplied to a mixing facility. The ready-mixed products are transported to a storage silo by a screw conveyor. The mix is then supplied to the packing station where it is discharged and filled into paper bags. The bags are piled onto a pallet and sealed by PE film. The pallets are then stored outside ready for expedition. Technical data: The following technical information based on DoPs of the delivered products is relevant for the declared products: Declared unit: The declared unit is 1 kg of KNAUF gypsum plaster as an average of KNAUF gypsum plaster Bulgips Start, MP75, MP75 L, MP75 SL and ROTBAND.
